title: Red panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,30 62,30' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,30 50,30' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 56,30 50,30' fill='#5ad1ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='36' r='9' fill='#b83b1d'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='9' fill='#b83b1d'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#f6e2cf'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#f6e2cf'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='#d94f26'/>
  <!-- white face markings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#fbe9d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='47' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#fbe9d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='47' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#fbe9d8'/>
  <!-- tear marks -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#8a2a12'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='57' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#8a2a12'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='3.6' fill='#2b1a14'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='3.6' fill='#2b1a14'/>
  <circle cx='40.2' cy='47.6' r='1.2' fill='#fff6ea'/>
  <circle cx='62.2' cy='47.6' r='1.2' fill='#fff6ea'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='4.5' ry='3.2' fill='#2b1a14'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44,63 Q50,68 56,63' stroke='#8a2a12' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
